title: The Sign of Jonah and the Return of the Unclean Spirit
description: Scribes and Pharisees demand a sign from Jesus, but he answers that this evil and unfaithful generation will receive no other sign than the sign of the prophet Jonah – just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the depths of the earth. The men of Nineveh, who turned from their ways at Jonah’s preaching, and the queen of the South, who came to hear Solomon’s wisdom, will rise up at the judgment and condemn this generation, for here is something greater than both Jonah and Solomon. Jesus concludes with an illustration about an unclean spirit that returns to its empty, swept, and adorned house with seven spirits worse than itself – so it will also be with this evil generation.
